description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Validator class, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It includes static properties for user agent signatures related to validators and methods to match user agent strings against these signatures and to identify the browser type as 'validator'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Validator
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop to identify and match web validator user agents based on predefined signatures.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent string matches any of the validator signatures.
